entities.summary: Hilde Schramm is a German politician for Alliance 90/The Greens. Internationally, she is best known as the daughter of the German architect and high-ranked Nazi Party official Albert Speer (1905–1981), and the younger sister of Albert Speer Jr. (1934–2017).
